title: mRNA vaccine platform from modified nucleosides to pandemic-scale realization
sourceNativeSummary: Early mRNA vaccination concepts faced inflammatory response, inefficient expression and delivery constraints; the 2005 modified-nucleoside result removed one mechanistic barrier, but platform realization still required delivery, antigen design, trials, manufacturing and exceptional institutional investment.
rivalOrBoundary: The 2020 COVID-19 mRNA vaccines were a realization of a much longer platform trajectory rather than a one-year invention.
